texts.zh: 一小队精挑细选的特工在经过严密伪装之后出发前往[target.owner.GetName]境内。每一个人都会装作一名求职者。一部分人将会携带推荐信，找和关键设施运营相关的工作；其他人则要在背地里试试运气。
texts.en: A small and select group of operatives has departed for the [target.owner.GetName] under tight aliases. Each will pose as a worker seeking employment. Some are carrying statements of recommendation and will seek work close to key facilities; others will try their luck in shadier parts of the installation.

texts.zh: 一小队精挑细选的特工在经过严密伪装之后出发前往[target.owner.GetName]境内。他们中间有一个假扮工匠家庭，希望能够寻得新的生意机遇。他们会尝试在[target.GetName]摆零售地摊以出售自己的手工制品。
texts.en: A small and select group of operatives has departed for the [target.owner.GetName] under tight aliases. Amongst them is a supposed family of artisans, seeking new business opportunities. They will try to establish a retail presence on [target.GetName] in order to sell their wares.

texts.zh: 一批专业的特工已经到达[target.owner.GetName]境内。他们使用一艘不起眼的货运飞船作为掩护。这艘舰船在接近[target.owner.GetAdj]国境的时候被安排了一场非致命性的爆炸，使得其尽可能接近[target.solar_system.GetName]星系。辐射将会倾泻出来充满了整个船舱内部，这样我们的特工就能秘密隐藏在它不可见的受保护核心中。
texts.en: A batch of operatives has left for the [target.owner.GetName]. Their cover involves piloting a nondescript cargo vessel. The ship is rigged for a non-lethal explosion as it approaches the [target.owner.GetAdj] border - as close as it can get to the [target.solar_system.GetName] system. Radiation will appear to flood the interior of the vessel as our operatives secrete themselves within its invisibly-shielded core.

texts.zh: 一批专业的特工已经到达[target.owner.GetName]境内。他们使用一艘不起眼的货运飞船作为掩护。它的货架上装满了对[target.owner.GetAdj]的扫描器会显示为稀有水晶和其他珍贵矿物的物件。我们相信，最简单直白的策略能够达到最好的障眼法效果。
texts.en: A batch of operatives has left for the [target.owner.GetName]. Their cover involves piloting a nondescript cargo vessel. Its hold is packed with what will appear to [target.owner.GetAdj] scanners as Rare Crystals and other precious minerals. We trust that the bare-faced simplicity of this strategy will serve as its own bluff.

texts.zh: 我方特工报告[root.target.owner.GetAdj]的国内已经发生了剧烈的变化：我们的目标不再有效。
texts.en: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer viable.

texts.zh: 我方的数名特工已经被允许登陆[target.GetName]设施。其他未获得授权的特工则继续分散在邻近星系。在这里他们可以转换成备用的掩护身份以进一步支援整个行动。
texts.en: A number of our operatives have been accepted aboard the [target.GetName] facility. Those who haven't been granted work there have dispersed to neighboring systems. There they will switch to backup cover identities and lend support to the overall operation.

texts.zh: 对方已经上钩了，我们的特工已经“遁入黑暗”，进而在敌对设施内部展开工作。间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]将会等待进一步的讯息信号。
texts.en: The bait has been taken, and our operatives have 'gone dark' as they work to establish themselves within the hostile facility. Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] will await further signals from them.

texts.zh: 我方特工报告[root.target.owner.GetAdj]的国内已经发生了剧烈的变化：我们的目标不再有效。
texts.en: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer viable.

texts.zh:
一段加密的信号自[target.owner.GetName]传来，表明我们的特工现在已经准备就绪。

他们的身份伪装已经深入到了一定程度，我们的特工事实上已经和那里的人员打成一片。通过友情聚餐、共享娱乐，以及日常社交活动，他们在[target.GetName]设施获得了不少能用于进入核心系统的线索。
texts.en:
A coded signal has arrived from within the [target.owner.GetName], indicating that our operatives now stand ready.

They have worked their cover roles to such a degree, our operatives have actually developed a rapport with local personnel. A number of useful points of entry have been noted during friendly meals, shared entertainments and day-to-day socializing aboard the [target.GetName] facility.

texts.zh: 一段加密的信号自[target.owner.GetName]传来，表明我们的特工现在已经准备就绪。间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经着手准备在可能的情况下撤出他们，然而机会十分渺茫。
texts.en: A coded signal has arrived from within the [target.owner.GetName], indicating that our operatives now stand ready. Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has made preparations to extract them where possible, however their chances are slim.

texts.zh: 我方特工报告[root.target.owner.GetAdj]的国内已经发生了剧烈的变化：我们的目标不再有效。
texts.en: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer viable.

texts.zh:
我们成功地破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施上面的军用支援结构。我们的特工报道了在他们的设备激活后，周边工作的人出现了少量的伤亡。

我们发动的这次打击扰乱了[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName]的作战后勤，对方不会对其视而不见的。

我们现在必须考虑能否为我们的行动开脱。在未来任何针对[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]空间的行动都需要我们尽可能地维持掩护——也就是说，我们要把慎重放在第一要位……
texts.en:
We have successfully sabotaged a military support structure aboard the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. Our operatives report minor casualties amongst those working nearby at the time their device activated.

This blow we've dealt to combat logistics within the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName] will not go unnoticed by them.

We must now consider the deniability of our own actions. Any future operations in [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] space will require us to maintain as much cover as we can - that is, assuming we wish to prioritize such discretion...

texts.zh:
我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系及其周边的商业利益发动了一次打击。由于当地星系的交通控制者手忙脚乱地制定新的物流模式，贸易舰船已经堵塞了所有的运输航线。

我们现在必须考虑能否为我们的行动开脱。在未来任何针对[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]空间的行动都需要我们尽可能地维持掩护——也就是说，我们要把慎重放在第一要位……
texts.en:
We have struck a blow to commercial interests in and around the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Trading vessels are already clogging up the shipping lanes as local space traffic controllers scramble to draw up new holding patterns.

We must now consider the deniability of our own actions. Any future operations in [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] space will require us to maintain as much cover as we can - that is, assuming we wish to prioritize such discretion...

texts.zh:
我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系内的民用设施进行了一次成功的爆破。随后而来的混乱证明了我们目标的成功实现。

我们现在必须考虑能否为我们的行动开脱。在未来任何针对[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]空间的行动都需要我们尽可能地维持掩护——也就是说，我们要把慎重放在第一要位……
texts.en:
We have struck a a successful blow to civic infrastructure in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. The ensuing chaos should serve our goals well.

We must now consider the deniability of our own actions. Any future operations in [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] space will require us to maintain as much cover as we can - that is, assuming we wish to prioritize such discretion...

label.zh: 谨慎是留给懦夫的。拆毁这个恒星基地。
label.en: Discretion is for the meek. Wreck this starbase.

label.zh: 也对防御平台发动打击。
label.en: Strike at the Defense Platforms as well.

texts.zh: 间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告道，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的特工小队必须放弃目前打算破坏[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]位于[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]星系目标的计划。[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]内部发生了急剧的变化，我们之前的准备工作成为了赘余。我们应该明智地挑选一个不同的目标。
texts.en: Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] team of operatives must abandon their efforts to sabotage [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Drastic changes to the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] interior have made our efforts so far redundant. We would be wise to choose a different target.

texts.zh: 入侵者们已经越过了我们在[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系的边境，并破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施的一部分。这些破坏分子显然是在为某个外国势力卖命；我们的反间谍部队必须提高警戒并尝试抓住这些特工。
texts.en: Intruders have violated our borders in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system, wrecking part of the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. These saboteurs appear to have been acting on behalf of a foreign power; our counter-espionage forces are on high alert to try and capture these operatives.

texts.zh:
未知的破坏分子在[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系发动了袭击，破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施的部分功能。

我们的反间谍部门推断这是外国势力从中作梗而不是本国的威胁。我们已经提高了受影响宇域的安全等级，希望能够擒拿这些特工。
texts.en:
Unknown saboteurs have struck at the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system, wrecking part of the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility.

Our counter-espionage service suggests this is likely the work of foreign actors, rather than any home-grown threat. We have increased security around the affected region of space in the hopes of capturing these operatives.

texts.zh: 一个外国实体突破了我们位于[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系的边境，放肆地扰乱了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施的平稳运行。我们暂时无法确信这些破坏分子是如何如此有效地进入我国国界，但是我们提高了内部的安全级别以直接应对这次威胁。
texts.en: A foreign entity has breached our borders in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system and has wantonly disrupted the smooth running of [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. We cannot yet ascertain how these saboteurs gained entry so effectively, however we have increased our internal security in direct response.
